notes.synthetic.digitalKeptAsVoice: 1 known limit: the DMR handheld conversation's first file, recorded before its channel has the 4 TDMA votes that bar it (a fresh channel holds no digital prior yet).
notes.synthetic.falseVoice: 2: that file, and the FM carrier whose audio is noise keyed like speech (no digital prior, so no content check).
notes.synthetic.missedVoice: 1: the first of the 12 dB speech overs, never voiced.
notes.capture: Calibrated on the reference labelled capture set (18 ten-second captures of one land-mobile band, run as one session). 1 known limit there: a DMR transmission that reads analog FM on a channel with no digital prior yet; its replay decode lands during the file, which finishes as voice. Another capture set needs its own limits (--thresholds).
